behaviors.given: a full pipeline run using stub providers
behaviors.when: the explorer, planner, contract evaluator, and generator are invoked
behaviors.then: each invocation is assembled through the provider-independent envelope path and records role-attributed evidence
behaviors.observableResult: events.jsonl contains one matching envelope evidence event for every scoped stub invocation and no scoped invocation lacks one

behaviors.source: GH #99 AC2 and Scope boundary; ADR 0002
behaviors.given: the same manifest version and declared artifact set containing behavior, gate, finding, and checkpoint IDs
behaviors.when: Kiro-, Claude-, and Codex-named stub adapters receive the envelope
behaviors.then: their logical artifact classes and order are identical and every stable ID is preserved
behaviors.observableResult: the stub captures compare equal after excluding provider wrapper syntax and still contain each seeded stable ID

behaviors.given: an unchanged manifest version and artifact set
behaviors.when: the same role envelope is assembled repeatedly
behaviors.then: normalized prompt bytes and logical evidence are identical
behaviors.observableResult: repeated assembly comparisons are byte-equal and deep-equal

behaviors.given: a scoped role manifest and either an undeclared context class or content over its byte budget
behaviors.then: preparation fails as CONFIGURATION before provider dispatch and does not truncate content
behaviors.observableResult: the stub provider is not called and the failure names the undeclared class or actual and allowed byte sizes

behaviors.source: GH #99 What to build; PRD Size evidence
behaviors.given: completed scoped invocations with provider token-count names exposed in different combinations
behaviors.then: each invocation records prompt bytes, ordered included artifact classes and IDs, omitted classes, manifest version, and exactly the exposed named token counts
behaviors.observableResult: every scoped event has exact envelope evidence and includes or omits each token-count name according to its provider result

behaviors.given: multiple slices whose invocations have exact prompt sizes and mixed availability of named token counts
behaviors.then: exact prompt-byte and available token-count totals appear per slice and for the run without synthetic unavailable fields
behaviors.observableResult: summary totals equal the fixture values and token names absent from a level's inputs are not rendered at that level

behaviors.given: required envelope content exceeds a role budget by at least one byte
behaviors.then: assembly fails with actual and allowed byte sizes and returns no truncated prompt
behaviors.observableResult: existing one-byte-over budget tests remain green

behaviors.source: PRD Solution and Implementation Decisions: focused fresh invocations
behaviors.given: initial and applicable revision or repair inputs containing ordered role markers and forbidden historical-context markers
behaviors.then: role-specific order remains and prior conversations, other-role conversations, resolved findings, and passing raw logs remain excluded
behaviors.observableResult: ordered markers appear in manifest order and every forbidden marker is absent from the assembled prompts

behaviors.source: GH #99 additive scope; PRD focused assembly
behaviors.given: a legacy direct generator execution without an explorer context artifact
behaviors.then: the existing full-context fallback remains accepted and measured
behaviors.observableResult: the fallback prompt contains the supplied context and carries the generator manifest version

behaviors.given: a run summary with existing lifecycle, cost, tool-call, gate, stable-copy, and per-run-copy data
behaviors.when: prompt and token totals are added
behaviors.then: all existing summary fields and both output copies remain
behaviors.observableResult: logger tests still observe prior columns, gate sections, and identical stable and archived summaries

behaviors.given: an exact assembled prompt passed through AgentProvider.invoke
behaviors.when: the Kiro, Claude, and Codex command builders prepare their invocations
behaviors.then: Kiro uses the unchanged prompt as its final argument and Claude and Codex use it unchanged on stdin while retaining provider-owned command syntax
behaviors.observableResult: adapter command-shape tests observe the exact marker at the existing argument or stdin location with existing flags intact
